issues.reason: Every `Degree` form in the instruction set takes the property-bearing entity first — `(Degree alice tall very)`, `(Degree sk_soup_1 hot excessive)` — so putting the reified state witness there is ill-typed (it reads as the state being very young, not the galaxy).
A past progressive emits both atoms per "Bob was cooking" → `(Past sk_cook_1) (Ongoing sk_cook_1)`; `Ongoing` alone places a forming that the same seal dates 12.713 billion years ago in the present.

`CoAgent` is defined as "an animate co-participant" and `Instrument` as a means that is "never a person", so an inanimate co-participant falls to the preposition-named oblique whose "head is the preposition actually used" — `(With sk_form_1 sk_star_1)`.

"its star" is a definite possessive NP and `(Possession <possessed> <possessor>)` is that NP's own encoding (*Possessive / genitive NP*: "her sister" → `Member` + `Possession`), not a predication of the sealed proposition, so it projects beside the typing atom without asserting anything the speaker does not presuppose.

The standing half is that "just" leaves no trace at all — an exclusive reading would license an `(Only …)` tag; the failing half is the confidence claim (no rule ties a particle to confidence), and this minimizing "just" over an already-unlicensed periphrastic progressive has no carrier, so "leave the unrepresentable adverbial out rather than mis-slot it" applies.

gaps_confirmed: periphrastic progressive "in the process of V-ing" — none of the four licensed `Ongoing` markers
comitative "with" naming an inanimate, non-volitional co-participant — `CoAgent` is animate-only and `Instrument` is means-only, so neither role is available
new_gaps: the minimizing/approximative "just" — the focus-particle section covers only the exclusive "only / just / solely" sense, and nothing carries the minimizing one

a possessive NP inside a seal — the projection rule names only the definite referent's `Member` / `Name` typing atom, leaving the placement of its `(Possession …)` atom (inside or outside the seal) undecided
